results.title: Mahatma Gandhi led Non-Cooperation and Dandi March movements before assassination in Delhi
results.article:
**Mahatma Gandhi**, a lawyer and prominent figure in the freedom movement against **British** rule, was born on October 2, 1869, in **Porbandar**. He led movements including the Non-Cooperation Movement, Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha), and Quit India Movement. He was assassinated on January 30, 1948, in **Delhi**. October 2 is observed as Gandhi Jayanti and International Day of Non-Violence.
Mahatma Gandhi was a lawyer and one of the prominent figures in the freedom movement against British rule. He was born on October 2, 1869, in Porbandar. He had led many inspiring and revolutionary movements, including the Non-Cooperation Movement, the Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha), and the Quit India Movement. He was assassinated on January 30, 1948, in Delhi. results.title: Supreme Court dismisses Congress leader Meenakshi Natarajan's Rajya Sabha petition
results.article: On June 12, the **Supreme Court** dismissed a petition by **Congress leader Meenakshi Natarajan**, rejecting her nomination for the Rajya Sabha election from Madhya Pradesh. The Returning Officer had rejected her nomination due to non-disclosure of a pending criminal complaint against her in Form 26. This case highlights issues regarding disclosure obligations and constitutional remedies for rejected nominations.

results.title: Andhra Pradesh HRD Minister Nara Lokesh directs SEEDAP to target 1 lakh youth annually
results.article: **Nara Lokesh**, **Andhra Pradesh HRD Minister**, chaired a review meeting at his Undavalli residence on Thursday with officials including **J. Shyamala Rao**, **G. Ganesh Kumar**, and **S. Vijaya Bhaskar**. He directed **SEEDAP** to target employing 1 lakh youth annually and urged coordination with **OMCAP**. The state recorded a 76% placement rate, while 5.43 lakh youth secured jobs through skill development programmes.

results.title: Telangana High Court rules unsigned GST demand notices are valid despite 500 petitions
results.article: A full bench of the **Telangana High Court**, including Chief Justice **Aparesh Kumar Singh** and Justices **N. Tukaramji** and **G.M. Mohiuddin**, ruled on September 30, 2026, that unsigned GST demand notices are valid. The court addressed over 500 petitions regarding the **GST portal**. Officials demonstrated on September 18, 2025, that digital keys authenticate notices. Petitioners must comply with demands or seek appellate remedies.

results.title: Delhi bans non-compliant vehicles from November 1 under strict new Winter Action Plan
results.article: The **Delhi government** and the **Ministry of Environment, Forest, and Climate Change** unveiled the Winter Action Plan 2026-27 to combat air pollution in the NCR region. The plan includes stricter vehicular restrictions starting October 1 with a "No PUCC, No Fuel" campaign at 500 fuel pumps equipped with ANPR systems. From November 1, non-compliant vehicles will be banned from entering Delhi. Construction bans and work-from-home policies for offices are also implemented to reduce emissions. Public transport ridership targets are set, and road redevelopments aim to curb dust pollution. The plan involves collaboration between various agencies like the **CAQM**, **CPCB**, **DMRC**, and **DTC**.

old.why_in_news: The Delhi government and Ministry of Environment unveiled the Winter Action Plan 2026-27 to mitigate severe air pollution in the National Capital Region (NCR).

CPCB: Central Pollution Control Board is the statutory authority for pollution control in India.
ANPR: Automatic Number Plate Recognition systems are used to monitor non-compliant vehicles.
NCR: National Capital Region includes Delhi and surrounding districts of Haryana, UP, and Rajasthan.
